selftext:
ALL BULLSHIT --- THIS IS JUST FOR TEXT REQUIREKMENTS XCraft represents a persistent, browser and mobile-based 4X space strategy simulation structured around planetary logistics, fleet command, and territorial warfare. Players establish command over an initial colony within contested galactic sectors, managing infrastructure, research trees, and resource extraction pipelines across distinct technological and biological factions, notably Terrans, Xerj, and Tosses.

The v18 iteration targets systemic balance and engine performance across core gameplay loops. Fleet operational mechanics receive recalibrated warp travel equations and resource consumption curves, making long-distance incursions require tighter supply line planning. Defense structures and planetary shield generators feature revised damage absorption thresholds to reduce early-game raiding exploitation without stalling offensive momentum.

Resource extraction ratios have been re-indexed. High-tier mining facilities now yield scaled outputs based on local planetary composition rather than static baseline values. This forces territorial expansion and conflict over contested, mineral-dense asteroids and frontier sectors.

Combat resolution logic in v18 introduces updated tracking metrics for mixed fleet engagements. Interceptors, cruisers, and capital flagships process hit calculations through revised armor mitigation algorithms, preventing monoculture fleet spam from dominating large-scale fleet engagements.

User interface performance across the planetary management screen has been streamlined to reduce input lag during high-volume queue additions. Fleet movement dispatch screens feature clarified flight time projections and fuel burn calculations.

The update consolidates backend stability for high-concurrency alliance wars. Server-side tick calculations for synchronized raids and joint defensive positions now resolve with lower latency, preventing dropped inputs during critical fleet interception windows. Overall, v18 establishes a more balanced, resource-conscious meta for competitive expansion and tactical fleet operations.
